title: Assess and manage AI product risk
summary: Before deploying or materially changing an AI-enabled product or internal decision workflow. An approved use-case risk assessment, evaluation record and monitored deployment decision with stop conditions.
outcomes: An approved use-case risk assessment, evaluation record and monitored deployment decision with stop conditions.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before deploying or materially changing an AI-enabled product or internal decision workflow.

parts.title: Define the AI use case and affected people
parts.guidance: Record the intended users, decisions supported, model and data providers, prohibited uses and the consequences of errors. Identify whether personal data, regulated activity or high-consequence decisions need specialist review.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Agree risk ownership and acceptance criteria
parts.guidance: Product, security, domain and legal reviewers decide the applicable controls and release criteria. Assign human authority for sensitive decisions and define when the system must abstain, escalate or stop.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Agree risk ownership and acceptance criteria

parts.title: Build and run representative evaluations
parts.guidance: Prepare authorized test data and scenarios covering expected use, misuse, failure, privacy and security. Record model versions, prompts, metrics and known limits and avoid exposing production secrets in evaluation logs.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review results and authorize a limited deployment
parts.guidance: The accountable reviewers evaluate unresolved failures, safeguards and rollback readiness. Approve only the specified scope and access, with an owner for user communication and incident handling.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review results and authorize a limited deployment

parts.title: Monitor outcomes and reassess material changes
parts.guidance: Track errors, user feedback, incidents and drift against the accepted thresholds. Re-run relevant evaluations when models, data, prompts or use cases change and pause uses that violate the agreed stop conditions.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An approved use-case risk assessment, evaluation record and monitored deployment decision with stop conditions.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
